description: This dataset is a relational SQL database of the Mathe platform. MathE is an online educational platform (mathe.ipb.pt) developed to support the teaching and learning of mathematics in higher education. The database contains information related to questions (covering 15 higher-education mathematics topics and their corresponding subtopics); teaching materials (such as PDFs and video lessons, associated with specific topics and subtopics); topics and subtopics (used to organize the content); keywords (associated with topics and subtopics to provide more fine-grained classification of the math content); student preferences (including user profile information such as learning style, hobbies, university, and country); and student assessment (including test results with details on question difficulty level, the student’s response (1 = correct, 0 = incorrect, −1 = “I don’t know”), and the time spent answering each question). The data spans from February 2019 to January 2026.
name: MathE Database 2026
headline: Relational SQL database for mathematics learning in Higher Education.
